format_definitions.nvfp4: olala_quant.nvfp4.quantize_nvfp4: e2m1, group 16, e4m3 block scale, fp32 global scale 448*6/amax (per tensor, per expert for 3D); underflow = nonzero block with scale zero or below 2^-6, flushed = scale zero, saturate = scale above 448 before the clamp
format_definitions.fp8: olala_quant.fp8.quantize_fp8: e4m3, one fp32 scale per output row (per expert row for 3D), scale floor 1/(448*512); underflow = nonzero row clamped to the floor
format_definitions.int4_g128: symmetric int4, group 128, scale = amax/7.5 stored fp16, q = clamp(round(w/scale), -8, 7), ties to even; underflow = fp16 scale below 2^-14, flushed = zero, saturate = amax/7.5 > 65504
format_definitions.mxfp4: OCP MX v1.0: e2m1, group 32, e8m0 scale 2^(floor(log2 amax) - 2) clamped to [-127, 127], elements clamped to +-6 then rounded to nearest e2m1 (ties to even code); underflow = exponent < -127
